title: An entropic characterization of Haag duality
summary: Motivated by Haag duality in quantum spin systems, we show that Haag duality for a pair of commuting factors generated by increasing sequences of finite-dimensional matrix algebras is equivalent to the asymptotic vanishing of a suitable conditional mutual information. For spin systems, let an annulus separate a finite region from the exterior. Haag duality then holds for a region $A$ if and only if the mutual information of the inner region and the exterior, conditioned on the part of $A$ inside the annulus, vanishes as the outer radius becomes large.
